result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. While traffic lights are present to control vehicle flow, there is a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and modern safety enhancements like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility thermoplastic ladder or zebra patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with a marked but faded zebra crosswalk and a curb ramp. While sidewalks are present and in good condition near the corner, the roadway pavement is degraded and there is a lack of pedestrian-specific signage or signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement within the roadway near the crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with mixed-use development and embedded trolley tracks. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the environment is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and potential tripping hazards from the tracks.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create a tripping hazard or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection crossing the main road

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with bold, continental-style markings to improve visibility and driver compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The environment features a wide roadway with integrated streetcar tracks and a modern mixed-use building. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the lack of frequent marked crossings and the presence of tracks create potential hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block and a slip/fall hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally down the center of the roadway.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the street in the foreground.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated crossing point near the building entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
